notes: §2002:13.16.38.4 GR6 applied to record entries under an OUTPUT CD (§2002:A.1.2.2 SR9): Form b (all positions floating) with zero gives all spaces (PA, CA, MA: 7 spaces); nonzero behaves as form a: one + or $ just before the first nonzero digit ("  +1.50", "  $1.50"), "-" gives space when positive (Table 10, "   1.50") and "-" before the decimal point position for -0.05 ("   -.05"); the second floating symbol bounds the digits so 12345 truncates to 345 ($$$9 -> "$345", +++9 -> "+345"); an embedded "/" is part of the string and takes the floating "+" just before the first nonzero digit (++/++9, 123 -> "  +123"). The --std 2002 run of the pinned build (dc1f2dcce8) matched the derived .out.
